yb89284c33d0.add: - **Pangong Tso:** name = '**high grassland lake**'; **brackish**, not freshwater; most of it lies in **Tibet (China)**; ringed by arid mountains.

y17393e5b18d.add: - **Kolleru** (AP) is fed by the **Budameru and Tammileru**, not directly by the Krishna; **Kanwar lake (Kabar Tal, Bihar)** = oxbow of the **Burhi Gandak** (UPSC 2023).

ya54d7c13ab1.add: - **Yaya Tso** (Changthang, ~4,820 m) = '**bird's paradise**'; not fed by the Sutlej.

yf6754f57d57.add: - **Tso Kar** is also in **Ladakh**; **Tsomgo (Changu)** is in **Sikkim**.

y2eacba8009d.add: - **Ghepan (Ghepan Gath)** – glacial lake in the **Lahaul valley, Himachal Pradesh**.

ye0edb34619e.add: - **Tehri dam** is on the **Bhagirathi** just below its confluence with the **Bhilangana** (old Tehri).

yc098f2b241c.add: - **Saran and Triveni canals** – both from the **Gandak** (barrage at **Valmikinagar**, West Champaran, Bihar).

y0fc31d457ff.add: - **Eden canal** (1873, Bardhaman, WB) is taken out of the **Damodar**.

yea19f11a137.add: - **Gang canal (Bikaner canal)** – from the **Sutlej** (Hussainiwala, Ferozepur); built by Maharaja **Ganga Singh**, opened **1927**.

y8f7b1990ac2.add: - **Teesta hydro projects:** stages III, V, VI in **Sikkim**; **Teesta Low Dam III and IV** in **West Bengal**.

y42ee82d5f5b.add: - **DVC (7 Jul 1948)** = **first multipurpose river valley project** of independent India (modelled on the TVA).

y41d90525b8c.add: - **Kishau dam** (Tons, HP–Uttarakhand border): water mainly for **Haryana**, Delhi, UP, Rajasthan; power to HP and Uttarakhand; six-state agreement **Sep 2026**.

ybb5ef1ab00f.add: - **Indira Gandhi canal** (started 1958) carries water of the **Sutlej, Beas and Ravi** from **Harike**.

yc487132d196.add: - **Tropic of Cancer** crosses the Chota Nagpur plateau near **Ranchi–Lohardaga**; CGPSC 2021 key: **South Koel–Damodar** cut it twice (disputed – only the **Mahi** is standard).

y8bbfa2ba19e.add: - **Farakka barrage** (1975) – main aim: divert Ganga water to **augment the Bhagirathi–Hooghly** (flush silt from Kolkata port).

y7b68fb9935e.add: - **Tilpara barrage** (Suri, Birbhum, WB) is on the **Mayurakshi** (Massanjore/Canada dam upstream).

yeaf263185e5.add: - **Ganga pollution** – chiefly untreated urban sewage and industrial effluent (not its sanctity); Namami Gange programme.

y5b65709101b.add: - **Sambhar** (near Jaipur, Rajasthan) = **largest inland salt-water lake** of India; Chilika is a coastal lagoon.
